outfit.name: 月白青竹暗纹改良无袖旗袍
outfit.prose: A moon-white silk sleeveless modern qipao woven with subtle bamboo jacquard and finished with deep teal piping and silver frog clasps, draped with a sheer celadon chiffon shawl across the elbows, paired with silver drop earrings and silver-buckled low-heel pumps.
